follow_ups.request: Broaden the Tools page to other projects and tools from ALPINNO, and add a recap and link to 11 / 1000.

follow_ups.changes: Kept tools.html as the stable route, updated its heading and metadata, renamed the English menu entry and homepage callout, and added a text project feature linking to the artist’s Italian page. Preserved the existing software entries.
follow_ups.publication: English local preview only; approval and multilingual publication remain pending.
follow_ups.validation: Production checks passed for 25 HTML pages; HTML validation passed for all nine affected English pages; clean build and public artifact checks passed. Desktop and 390px browser review confirmed the project card, link and navigation layout. Official project URL returned HTTP 200.

follow_ups.request: Confirm that existing ShareWise links remain valid in the new version, especially the URL embedded in the app, and make service pages work as self-contained landing pages.
follow_ups.changes: Retained the homepage and both ShareWise URL forms. Added concise visible ALPINNO founder context to Services and AIdea, and named Pier Paolo in ShareWise’s existing provider background. Kept both short expert biographies on the Rowan offering page.
follow_ups.publication: Local English preview only; no publication or app changes.
follow_ups.validation: Production validation passed for 25 HTML files; HTML validation passed for the three changed pages; clean build and public artifact checks passed. Both direct ShareWise URL forms returned HTTP 200 in the local preview, and the built page matched the source. Desktop browser review confirmed the compact provider introduction and enquiry action.

follow_ups.request: Replace founder-led positioning with senior or executive-level expertise, consider Italian creativity in the homepage line, and suggest an About-page network presentation in chat only.

follow_ups.about_page: Left unchanged. Suggestions about showing collaborators, specialist capacity, client work and previous experience are for discussion only; no new team, client, partner or staffing claims were added.
follow_ups.validation: Production checks passed for 25 HTML pages, HTML validation passed for the changed pages, and clean build and public artifact checks passed. Desktop and 390px browser review confirmed the revised homepage line fits. About-page bytes remained unchanged.

follow_ups.request: Implement the specialist-network positioning on the local English About page. Use capabilities rather than adding company names or testimonials, and retain existing career references.
follow_ups.changes: Replaced founder-led positioning with senior expertise and a network matched to each engagement. Clarified Pier Paolo’s lead-contact role and added conditional capability examples for industrial design and 3D drawings, patent attorney support, and computer simulation including multiphysics. Updated About metadata and the discovery summary.
follow_ups.preserved: Existing founder biography, career references, dates, images, qualifications and links are unchanged. No new company names, collaborator names, client logos or testimonials were added. The network is described as project-dependent.
follow_ups.publication: Local English review only; multilingual work and publication remain pending approval.
follow_ups.validation: Source, HTML and clean-build checks passed. The founder biography and all existing About-page links were preserved. Desktop and 390px layouts were reviewed, and completion was saved with the values follow-up in the local Git checkpoint.

follow_ups.request: Resume the English local preview and reflect people-first collaboration, creativity, strategic perspective before implementation, and adaptive delivery focused on client value. Remove the national-label slogan and avoid rigour as a company value.
follow_ups.changes: Replaced the homepage line with People first. Progress with purpose. Added Based in Switzerland. Working internationally. Integrated the values into the existing About and Services copy instead of adding a lengthy manifesto. Added a short explanation of the Montico project’s relevance to ALPINNO.
follow_ups.preserved: No new client names, collaborator names, company logos or testimonials. Existing founder biography, career references, specialist-network examples and fixed ShareWise URLs remain intact.
follow_ups.publication: Local English review only. No multilingual publication has been authorised.
follow_ups.validation: Production checks passed for 25 HTML pages with zero warnings. HTML validation passed for index, about, services and tools. Homepage and all existing ShareWise URL forms returned HTTP 200, including successful slashless redirection. Founder biography and existing About links are unchanged. url_preservation.requirement: Preserve existing public homepage and ShareWise URLs, including links already distributed to prospects and embedded in the ShareWise app.
url_preservation.implementation: The ShareWise directory and index.html remain in the public build at their original paths. The page keeps its existing canonical URL. Existing app links using these addresses require no update.
url_preservation.checked: The homepage, index.html, sharewise/, and sharewise/index.html returned HTTP 200 in the new local preview. The slashless sharewise route reached sharewise/ successfully. The rebuilt ShareWise page matches the current source bytes.

landing_page_principle: The homepage organises the offerings. Each service or product page is independently shareable and explains the offering, relevant people or provider, practical details and next step. Brief contextual repetition is intentional; visitors should not need the About page to understand who delivers the work.

values: Creative exploration of ideas and alternatives
Strategic perspective and clear priorities before implementation
Practical delivery that learns from client and user feedback and adapts to evolving needs
current_positioning.network: Senior leadership with project-specific specialist support; no additional companies or testimonials named.
